topic.title: Hangman Step 3
topic.description: Adds a while loop so the player keeps guessing until the word is fully revealed. Introduces loop termination based on a win condition.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Using a while loop that checks if any blanks remain in the display list to continue or stop the game.
learningNotes.challenges: Updating the display list correctly on each iteration and detecting the win.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Step 4: add lives counter and ASCII art stages.

files.description: Hangman step 3: while loop for repeated guessing.
